messages:
nina: Quick heads-up: prepping release notes + internal announce for runtime v2.14 micro-deploy. Need final phrasing for pinning + rollback steps.

chris: drop the customer-impact line first so support gets context. also include canary image SHA and exact region cutovers.

nina: draft copy below. keeping it short for the internal blast:
```
- Change: runtime v2.14 (request-level batching)
- Impact: expected 12-18% p95 token latency improvement on xlarge GPUs; no model changes
- Canary: image sha256:ab12c3...ef45 (canary-1)
- Rollout plan: staged migration over 48h; EU cutover at 2026-04-07 03:00 UTC
- Pinning: customers may pin to runtime 2.13 via /api/v1/pin until 2026-05-31
- Safety: automatic fallback to 2.13 via routing policy if error-rate or latency regressions exceed thresholds; on-call can initiate immediate pinning
- Deploybot: will post start/complete messages in this channel
```

jordan: looks good. Ops request: add a succinct rollback checklist for the announce so SRE/support can action quickly.

nina: adding an ops checklist now.

nina: Ops checklist:
- Run: `tools/pin-runtime --version 2.13 --scope hosted`
- Confirm: traffic shifted and KV cache warmed (~5-8m)
- Monitor: 5xx rate, p95 latency, token-cost delta for 15m
- Escalate: ping infra-oncall if errors persist >10m

infra-oncall: I'm available during the window. Recommend spelling out monitoring dashboards link and the emergency rollback command.

chris: good point 1 add link and command.

nina: updated final draft with dashboard link and emergency command:
- Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/abc123/runtime-metrics
- Emergency pin: `./scripts/emergency-pin 2.13`

deploy-bot: :robot_face: Canary deploy initiated for runtime v2.14 canary-1 at 8765456792. Hooks: latency, 5xx, token-cost.

jordan: thanks. Nina can you post the internal announce once you confirm the EU cutover time with infra? I'll prep the one-line hosted status blurb for customers.

nina: will confirm and post by EOD. tagging @infra-oncall before final send.
